page.content:
Walled Earth Kingdom capital that denies the war.

How Ba Sing Se connects

  • Faction: Earth Kingdom — Ba Sing Se is the Earth Kingdom capital.
  • Character: Azula — Azula's coup takes Ba Sing Se from the inside.

What is Ba Sing Se?

Ba Sing Se is the Earth Kingdom's enormous capital, ringed by walls, run by the Dai Li, and famous for the rule that there is no war in Ba Sing Se.

Key threads lead to Earth Kingdom and Azula.
